exact: ubiquitin-dependent protein breakdown via the multivesicular body pathway
ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the MVB pathway
ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolism via the MVB pathway
ubiquitin-dependent protein degradation via the multivesicular body pathway

definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a protein or peptide covalently tagged with ubiquitin, via the multivesicular body (MVB) sorting pathway; ubiquitin-tagged proteins are sorted into MVBs, and delivered to a lysosome/vacuole for degradation.
label: ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the multivesicular body sorting pathway
